stops.note: to stretch toward, to pay heed, from ad- (toward) and tendere (to stretch)
stops.meaning: to stretch toward, to pay heed

stops.note: carried into French for waiting for or paying heed to something
stops.meaning: to wait for, to pay heed

stops.note: settled as the English word for being present at or paying attention to something
stops.meaning: to be present at, or to pay attention to something

current_meaning: to be present at an event, or to pay attention to something
